jobDescription: Role Description Epiq, the world’s leading Legal Solutions provider, is changing the legal tech game. We are looking for a Senior Director, Software Engineering – Data & AI Platforms to expand data and information management capabilities across our organization. The successful candidate will help deliver our vision for our Data & AI Platforms, working directly under the CTO, together with Product Management, Operations, AI/ML, and other stakeholders in the organization. The person will be a thought leader driving the Software Development function along with the Data Integration/Data Quality initiatives of the Epiq Service Cloud, including the data foundations that power our AI and Gen AI capabilities, and a tremendous team player who builds connections across the organization. This is still a hands-on role, so we are looking for someone who can not only set our vision to advance this capability but also help implement it, leading a team of 80- 100 people based primarily in India. The team is using a cloud-native, modern technology stack built on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes, and Power BI, with growing investment in streaming, Lakehouse, and Gen AI/vector infrastructure, among other things. This is a leadership role and requires working in our office premises in a hybrid model. Responsibilities Demonstrated hands-on software engineering background (e.g., Python, Scala, or Java), with a track record of personally writing, reviewing, and shipping production-grade code, not solely directing the work of others. Solid grounding in core engineering practices: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and formal code review standards. Experience designing and building APIs, services, and event-driven/ microservices architectures that other engineering and product teams build on top of. Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Formation) and containerized deployment (Docker/Kubernetes) from an ownership and architecture standpoint, not just as a consumer. Familiarity with secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices — dependency management, secrets management, and security review — particularly relevant given the sensitivity of legal data. Experience architecting for reliability and scale: observability (logging, monitoring, alerting), incident response, and performance/cost tuning of production data services. Develop a critical understanding of business data to proactively identify opportunities to improve data quality and deliver solutions and insights. Partner with AI/ML and Product teams to build the data foundations (pipelines, feature stores, vector search, RAG-ready datasets) that power our Gen AI and agentic product capabilities. Provide guidance for data integrity issues, ongoing maintenance, and data governance, including responsible-AI data practices such as lineage tracking and PII/PHI handling appropriate for legal data. Maintain detailed documentation of data collection methods and dependencies. Work with key stakeholders to understand BI/Analytics and reporting requirements. Conduct audits and troubleshoot tracking gaps to maintain data confidence and implement data standardization practices. Support a data-driven culture by educating the organization on everyday uses of data, and increasingly AI, as a resource. Work with our Data Science / Analytics organization to help achieve product goals, including supporting model evaluation and monitoring once in production. Qualifications Minimum Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study required. Master’s degree in a related field is highly desirable. Minimum of 15-20 years of technology leadership experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience leading teams building data platforms. Understanding of machine learning, with prior experience implementing end-toend ML-powered models highly desirable; exposure to Gen AI/LLM-based systems (RAG, vector search, prompt/eval pipelines) is a strong plus. AWS/Azure cloud experience around data integration technologies and frameworks. Knowledge of common ingestion patterns, ETL/ELT, and streaming architectures. Hands-on familiarity with modern data stack tooling (e.g., dbt, Spark/Databricksclass compute) and data observability/quality platforms. Proven experience working with large-scale data processing platforms and distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Snowflake, or similar), handling high-volume, high-velocity data at enterprise scale. Working knowledge of data governance/cataloging tools and vector database concepts. Knowledge of Agile development methodologies. Experience leading a Shared Services / Platform organization, with a client-first mentality and a collaborative, helpful attitude. Experience managing distributed teams across India and global time zones, with strong stakeholder management across US/UK/EU counterparts. Track record of managing and growing remote teams over time, including hiring, mentoring, and building out organizational capability as scope expands. Expert knowledge of data warehousing concepts and data schemas. Awareness of data privacy and security regulations relevant to legal/regulated data (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and how they intersect with AI system design. Prior experience in the legal industry or legal technology is a plus, though not required. High level of attention to detail, quality, and effective verbal and written communication skills along with excellent follow-through. jobDescription: About the Job: This is a full-time hybrid role for an e Discovery Project Manager/Associate Project Manager at Epiq in Hyderabad, with some flexibility for remote work. This role will be responsible for making sure the client receives world class service through day-to-day execution of multiple e Discovery projects with clear direction on the deliverables, managing deadlines and consulting the client with workflows across several stages of the EDRM Model. Please Note: This is an evergreen requisition created to build a pipeline of skilled e Discovery professionals for anticipated future openings at Epiq. Suitable candidates will be contacted and considered as and when relevant active positions become available. Essential Job Responsibilities Ensure effective control of all aspects of the e Discovery project from initial planning through final production and project closure. Host client kick-off calls and take lead on internal project workflow discussions. Obtain, examine, and prepare client data for Intake. Deliver media reports to the client, Coordinate FTP access setup for clients, User requests by coordinating with support teams. Submit work requests to coordinate data ingestion and deliver reports to clients. Coordinate with peer teams and clients on search term analysis and promotion of data to review platform. Handle review platform (Relativity or other proprietary platforms) specific items including but not limited to User requests, database management (archiving/deletion), creation of layouts/views/fields/choices/highlighting, creation, and execution of STR’s, creation and management of batch sets, reporting, creating, and delivering productions. Assist in troubleshooting and resolving any client issues with delivered or hosted data. Conduct the invoice review each month to validate client invoices before being delivered to the client. Correspond with client and internal teams as a single point of contact for multiple e Discovery projects and maintain consistent project documentation. Ensures continuity of client service between shifts by providing clear handoffs and client updates. Participate in process improvement initiatives and collaborate with teammates to standardize and improve the client experience.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable solutions, contributing to software development, and implementing modern AI capabilities that align with our product and solution offerings. As a Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect, you will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, leadership teams, clients, data scientists, consultants, DevOps engineers, and software engineers to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and AI-driven solutions. You will play a key role in translating complex business problems into scalable technical solutions while ensuring engineering excellence, maintainability, and long-term product success. Design, develop, and maintain APIs, services, and integrations that support enterprise applications and AI solutions.
